title: Conditional κ = 0.0036527403111 (+0.0086654621% over #7657) on the original-74 single-courier word
body:
## Original-74 signed result

The chart-373 contact from #7643 can be applied to Clear1nsight's #7657 construction while retaining its 226/990 courier, the deeper 513→127 route on role 46, and the complete ordered #7605 erasure interface. The independently checked frozen word has 76,672 events. The clean registered signed application supports **conditional κ = 0.0036527403111** on the #7113 caller. [Proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2f3815d83df05033693ce454acf2e5e2aa8160fa/research/original74-deep46-chart373/PROOF.md) · [Final receipt](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2f3815d83df05033693ce454acf2e5e2aa8160fa/research/original74-deep46-chart373/receipts/FINAL.json)

| Comparable original-74 application | Published κ | Absolute gain | Percentage gain |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| #7645, `8ee7e6869b57ce445dbebd1d720366eab1f8ca40` | 0.0036521182092 | +0.0000006221019 | +0.0170340023% |
| #7657, `944ca28a8caa7422ad50c634e3d9aeef7eca34eb` | 0.0036524238117 | +0.0000003164994 | +0.0086654621% |

Both comparable heads completed hosted native and full signed replay. Against their stronger framework points, 0.003652118209307 and 0.003652423811866 respectively, the public-point improvements are +0.000000622101793 (+0.0170339994%) and +0.000000316499234 (+0.0086654575%). Percentages use the exact decimal inputs before rounding. The maintainer-selected record remains #7000/#7001 at 0.00363005817. [Pin and replay authentication](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2f3815d83df05033693ce454acf2e5e2aa8160fa/research/original74-deep46-chart373/receipts/BASELINES.json)

## What this adds

The donor in chart 373 returns before the first exterior read at source clock 41172. The receiver returns before its read at 43553. One fewer paid MOVE per invocation changes the full 17-call paid counts by −34, +34, −17, −17, +17 at ranks 1 through 5. The verified invoice contains 110,264 paid positions, 22,461 productive positions, and an ordinary bound of 782,612,172. The stronger framework point and the directed crossing have distinct entries in the final receipt.

Clear1nsight's #7612 already attained the same tariff. On unit input 902 its zero-based CLEAR 44 erased zero, while #7605 and this word both erase −3/2. The other 73 erased forms agree. The original #7645 rechart already agrees with SYLforge's #7616 W1 after commuting disjoint entrance operations. DreamingOfClouds' #7617 includes the courier in a two-courier construction with 113 erasures. This package establishes the combined signed result on the original 74 erased values. [Historical comparison and receipts](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2f3815d83df05033693ce454acf2e5e2aa8160fa/research/original74-deep46-chart373/historical)

## Replay

From this head with CPython 3.12, no third-party Python dependencies are required.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/original74-deep46-chart373
```

The separate verifier checked both first reads, returns, 1,501 arbitrary-input endpoints, 630 private/COPY observations, and 74 owned erasures. Its price check uses the pinned invoice for unchanged caller charges. The native proof checks forward and adjoint maps with absolute phase, and the signed application rebuilds all charges, precision, tape and outer checks. A sign-flipped contact and a missing charge are among the rejected controls. The five inherited premises are native all-columns validity, owned erasure, uniform compilation, precision/fixed tape, and analytic recovery. The claims are finite and conditional. The CI prerequisite is the same historical replay repair that passed on #7647.
